11866|f3b1497b.name: Ilyenia Moonfire
11866|f3b1497b.text: The grace with which I fight is not something I can teach you, but I can teach you the use of various weapons.

1247|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Belm
1247|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

12577|c5ceacbe.name: Jarrodenus
12577|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

185403|3b44064a.name: Cyriden Farseeker
185403|3b44064a.text:
Work has been stymied as of late. Our dig sites have been overrun by both the Forsaken and the Cult of the Dark Strand. The Sentinels are keeping them corralled to the ruins. I just hope they don't cause too much damage while they're there.

The last item we recovered was a wooden effigy depicting two figures. I gave it to Relathor, and he's been trying to piece together its history. You can find him upstairs.

185403|7e1300bc.name: Cyriden Farseeker
185403|7e1300bc.text:
Elune-adore, traveler. I am Cyriden. My partner Relathor and I are working to unearth the lost artifacts of our people.

Much is remembered by the older kaldorei, but there is no telling what tales have been forgotten. Without our intervention, they will vanish from this world forever.

185404|1c902d7c.name: Relathor Moonsong
185404|1c902d7c.text: My partner and I are archaeologists, hoping to uncover the forgotten history of the kaldorei. It's hard work, but I feel an obligation to preserve the stories of those who came before me.

185404|632de2bf.name: Relathor Moonsong
185404|632de2bf.text:
Why yes! A fascinating statuette depicting two night elves at rest. Cyriden excavated it from Bathran's Haunt, just hours before the Forsaken encroached and forced him away from the ruins.

He gave it to me when he returned to the house, and I've been investigating it since.

It was carved from wood native to Ashenvale, and dates back thousands of years, approximately to the War of the Satyr. The two figures are male, but I haven't been able to glean any more information about who they were.

185404|73f07dec.name: Relathor Moonsong
185404|73f07dec.text:
Selling the statue? Most certainly not! When Cyriden handed it to me, it made me think of... feel... I don't know.

I seem to have lost my words.

My apologies. I probably sound foolish, getting attached to some frivolous curio. Regardless, I'm sorry to say that the statue is not for sale at this time.

2432|c5ceacbe.name: Darla Harris
2432|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

270637|3e0b4d08.name: Howin Kindfeather
270637|3e0b4d08.text: So many Wildhammer lives lost... whole families erased...

2835|c5ceacbe.name: Cedrik Prose
2835|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

3290|eb2466e3.name: Deek Fizzlebizz
3290|eb2466e3.text: Your current aptitude exceeds my instructional capabilities. You should enquire further with my fellow Gnome Trixie Quickswitch in Ironforge!

3391|8f749700.name: Gazlowe
3391|8f749700.text: Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.

3442|ef9d74c5.name: Sputtervalve
3442|ef9d74c5.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $N!

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

3453|48c11c0f.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
3453|48c11c0f.text: Something I can help you with, $N? There's a shipment I've got to see to otherwise.

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

4155|c7fcb1fe.name: Idriana
4155|c7fcb1fe.text: Welcome to the Bank of Darnassus. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

4262|a0975d94.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|a0975d94.text: I received the majority of my weapons training from Ilyenia Moonfire in the Warrior's Terrace.  You would do well to seek her out if you desire to learn the use of a new weapon.

4262|ce424d00.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|ce424d00.text: Of all the wondrous places within Darnassus, which would you have me direct you to?

4267|c5ceacbe.name: Daelyshia
4267|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4321|c5ceacbe.name: Baldruc
4321|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4407|c5ceacbe.name: Teloren
4407|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

5496|86b6c1ef.name: Sandahl
5496|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

5496|8fca8484.name: Sandahl
5496|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6791|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Wiley
6791|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

161-progress.name: Ashlan Stonesmirk
161-progress.text: You say somethin', sonny?  Can't hear a bloody thing besides the ringin' in me ears.  Say, what's that you got there?
161-progress.title: A Dark Threat Looms

199-progress.text: Did you happen to discover any clues, $N?
199-progress.title: A Dark Threat Looms

2160-progress.text: Hi there! Come in, take a seat by the fire and warm yourself with a flagon of ale.
2160-progress.title: Supplies to Tannok

3365-progress.name: Nori Pridedrift
3365-progress.text: I trust the scalding mornbrew got to Durnan on time!  Did you remember to bring me back my mug?
3365-progress.title: Bring Back the Mug

65602-accept.name: Takar the Seer
65602-accept.text:
You will need a powerful reagent to tempt an incubus -- an object that represents great devotion and love.

With my scrying, I have located a small figurine that should be suitable for your ritual.

Thousands of years ago, the figurine belonged to a young couple. The original owners are no more, but their keepsake has survived to the present day.

Follow the road north into Ashenvale, then west and past Maestra's Post. You will see a house nestled amongst the trees. There you will find what you seek.
65602-accept.title: What Is Love?

96339-complete.name: Innkeeper Wiley
96339-complete.text:
Wait, wait, you said your name was $N?

$N! I am so glad to finally meet you. Someone delivered a package here addressed to you and assured me that you would eventually come to pick it up. I tried to tell them that we don't do that around here, but before I could get a word in, they were already gone!

Your timing is great, too. It was gonna be lumped up with all the other garbage that I toss into the sea nightly.

What? We all do it. Ugh, just take your package and go!
96339-complete.title: Legacy Reward: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle

97253-progress.name: Wrenix the Wretched
97253-progress.text: Not another word out of you until your pockets are jingling with metal!
